iconicAnchor.label: Bauhaus preliminary course and workshop teaching
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: The preliminary course and workshops joined experiments in color, form, material, perception, craft, and production rather than prescribing one decorative look.

sources.title: Preliminary Course, Workshops and Bauhaus Diploma: What Made Training at the Bauhaus So Special?
supports: Bauhaus teaching centered experiments with color, form, material, and visual perception.
Students advanced from the preliminary course into workshops joining artistic and craft instruction.

sources.title: 14 Years of Bauhaus: A Chronology From Its Founding in 1919 to Its Closure in 1933
supports: The preliminary course addressed material, shaping, presentation, construction, rhythm, and formal and light contrasts.
Workshop practice connected artistic form with craft and later industrial production.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set. The lead clearly teaches elemental geometry, asymmetric, functional type, workshop material, retains its identity at card scale, and shows no visible anti-cue, integrity failure, or confusing overlap with neighboring styles. The independently approved lead is assets/refs/bauhaus-workshop/generated-lead.jpg. No support image is needed because the lead carries the direction without filler.
